info.title: Gasworks Observer — Ingest and Run API
info.description: Hand-authored (spec-first) OpenAPI for the Gasworks Observer metadata-only pilot: the machine ingest/capabilities/source-lifecycle plane and the viewer-authorized Run/work-run read plane. Strictly OpenAPI 3.0.3 — no 2020-12-only keywords (no if/then/else, const, or dependentRequired). Every observation payload is a closed, discriminated type (discriminator: kind); VCS references and run boundaries are themselves closed discriminated sub-unions. There are no free-form objects, untyped maps, or additionalProperties:true anywhere. The artifact is the source of truth; platform/endpoint/UI types and the fixture corpus are derived from it (see docs/design/gasworks-observer-mvp.md and the implementation plan).

servers.description: identity plane; the customer gateway fronts ingest, source-lifecycle, and viewer routes

get.description: Non-mutating capabilities/validation route used by setup and doctor. Returns supported schema versions, limits, the authenticated source binding, and server time. Accepts no client-supplied authoritative tenant/workspace.

post.description: Accept one contiguous immutable source range. Returns success only after the durability boundary accepts the complete range. Idempotent replay reports duplicates; conflicting content is quarantined, not last-write-wins.
Bind a predeclared endpoint source ID to the verified operator's workspace/workload subject. Ingest cannot self-enroll or take over a binding.
Permanently revoke a source binding. Irreversible: a replacement uses a new source ID. Restored backups must reapply the revocation ledger before serving or ingesting.
Atomically decommission a corrupt namespace and enroll its predeclared replacement with a content-free loss-range audit record. Requires both source-lifecycle permissions.

get.description: Initial page or updates_after incremental page for the viewer's workspace, with work-reference/origin filters. Authorization is at the datastore boundary, never post-query filtering.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Rows per page; default 50, clamped to [1,200].

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque keyset continuation token from a prior page.

parameters.name: updates_after
parameters.description: Incremental-poll cursor (updates_cursor from a prior read); returns only newer run revisions.

parameters.name: work_ref_project
parameters.description: Filter to runs referencing this Team Server project (bound into the page cursor).

parameters.name: work_ref_bead
parameters.description: Filter to runs referencing this bead (bound into the page cursor).

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Work-reference origin filter; default DECLARED. EXTRACTED never authorizes composition.

get.description: One run's projection detail with an ETag over (projection_version, projection_revision). A foreign or unauthorized run id is indistinguishable from a nonexistent one (404).

ETag.description: Entity tag over (projection_version, projection_revision) and, for work runs, the BTS evaluation watermark; drives conditional polling.

304.description: Not Modified; no body (conditional poll matched the current ETag).

get.description: Keyset-paginated typed evidence for a run, pinned to one projection revision. Content fields are absent under metadata-only policy. Responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. The stricter forge:observer.content.read gates any future content field.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Evidence rows per page; default 100, clamped to [1,500].

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque keyset continuation token pinning the projection revision.

get.description: Group-bead work-run composition over current BTS structure and declared references, with member/run caps, truncation markers, paged continuation, and an ETag. Non-group, foreign, and missing beads return the uniform 404. Partial BTS failure returns the Observer half with work_axis_available=false, never a cached substitute.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token binding (project, bead), viewer, permissions, filters, and version.

ETag.description: Entity tag over (projection_version, projection_revision) and, for work runs, the BTS evaluation watermark; drives conditional polling.

observerMachineKey.description: Source-bound machine credential (scope observer:ingest). The gateway resolves it to a verified typed RequestIdentity; the ingest credential cannot call source-lifecycle routes and never carries operator authority.

observerOperatorKey.description: Operator credential for the source-lifecycle plane (scopes observer:sources.enroll / observer:sources.decommission). Never written into daemon config/WAL or inherited by Codex.

forgeViewerKey.description: Forge-audience viewer credential for the Run API (scopes forge:observer.runs.read / forge:observer.evidence.read / the stricter forge:observer.content.read). Edge-injected; X-Gc-Identity is never client-supplied.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, unsupported schema version, or invalid page token.

Forbidden.description: Identity is not authorized for this route, tenant/workspace, or source.

Conflict.description: Sequence gap, source-binding, or immutable-observation conflict established synchronously.

Unprocessable.description: Typed payload invalid or batch range not contiguous.

RateLimited.description: Tenant/source rate limit; retry with backoff and Retry-After.

Unavailable.description: Durable sink unavailable; retry without advancing.

Watermark.description: A stable provider-file drain watermark. Carries no absolute path.

source_locator.description: Provider-relative locator; never an absolute path.

byte_offset.description: Bytes drained through this stable provider-file watermark.

ProcessIdentity.description: Exact OS process identity used for causal launch-lineage proof.

process_start_time.description: Kernel process start time (clock ticks); proves exact launch lineage.

WorkReference.description: An opaque link from a run to a Beads Team Server work item, with its origin discipline.

team_server_project_id.description: Opaque canonical Beads Team Server project ID; never a display name; never parsed for policy.

bead_id.description: Opaque bead identifier; never parsed for policy.

origin.description: DECLARED links come from the wrapper/lifecycle API and enter aggregates. EXTRACTED links are pattern-captured correlation evidence and never enter composition or totals. For EXTRACTED, team_server_project_id derives only from the daemon-stamped run context or a single configured default project; otherwise the reference is dropped with a diagnostic.

ExtractionProvenance.description: Deterministic extraction provenance for a VCS reference.

surface.description: The recognized record shape the reference was captured from.

pattern_id.description: Fixture-proven output-format pattern the extractor matched.

ContentReference.description: Independently verifiable CASS content reference. Reserved for the follow-on FULL track; never present under METADATA_ONLY. This shape is INTENTIONALLY PARTIAL: the immutable snapshot_id and the covered normalized-observation/byte range (spec line 351) join additively at the FULL follow-on gate, alongside the CASS receipt-lookup contract; do not treat the absence of those fields as a v1 omission.

blake3.description: Hex BLAKE3 over the exact transformed bytes.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 over the exact transformed bytes.

TransformedContent.description: Typed transformed-content payload. Reserved for FULL; absent (never empty) under METADATA_ONLY.

Provenance.description: Provenance carried by every observation. Metadata-only omits source_hash and content locators that would reveal captured bytes.

provider.description: Provider name when present, e.g. codex.

source_locator.description: Provider-relative locator; an absolute path never leaves the endpoint.

source_hash.description: Representation hash, present only when the active content policy permits it.

RunContext.description: Present exactly when the daemon stamped a declared, inherited, or lineage-proven attachment; absent for passive-session evidence.

membership_evidence.description: The evidence that authorized this attachment.

work_item_refs.description: Work references declared on the boundary; at most 32.

RunStartedBoundary.description: RUN_STARTED opens an explicit run. No drain fields exist on this shape.

RunEndedBoundary.description: RUN_ENDED closes an explicit run. No outcome field exists on a wrapper boundary.

drain_status.description: Present on a normal RUN_ENDED; absent on a launch-failure RUN_ENDED. Travels together with covered_watermark (a server-validated coupling, not a wire-schema one).

RunBoundaryPayload.description: A run boundary, discriminated on transition.

ProcessLifecyclePayload.description: Wrapper child process lifecycle. Exit status is process evidence; there is no outcome field.

exit_code.description: Process exit code; recorded as evidence, never converted to run success.

signal.description: Terminating signal number when the process was signalled.

SessionLifecyclePayload.description: Native provider session lifecycle evidence. Carries its own native_session_id and provider, plus an optional bounded model identifier.

native_session_id.description: The provider/native session id this evidence belongs to; bounded and non-empty.

provider.description: Provider name, e.g. codex; bounded and non-empty.

model.description: Optional bounded provider-reported model identifier; absent (never empty) when unknown.

MessagePayload.description: Message metadata. Under METADATA_ONLY only role/timing/bounded counts are present; content is absent (never an empty body).

ToolCallPayload.description: Tool call metadata. No command text, arguments, environment, url, or MCP name under METADATA_ONLY.

category.description: Normalized tool category; never a command, argument, url, or MCP name.

ToolResultPayload.description: Tool result metadata. No result body under METADATA_ONLY.

UsagePayload.description: A usage observation. Missing values stay absent; absence is never coerced to zero. Estimated values carry a price-table version (enforced by the server validator).

price_table_version.description: Present only when quality is ESTIMATED (a server-validated coupling, not a wire-schema one).

VcsReferencePayload.description: A deterministically extracted commit or pull-request reference, discriminated on ref_kind. Correlation evidence only: it never affects run membership and never authorizes composition into totals.

CommitVcsReference.description: A COMMIT VCS reference with a full-length-hex identifier.

identifier.description: A full 40- or 64-hex commit identifier. Abbreviated hashes are excluded from v1 (bare short hex is indistinguishable from hex-encoded secrets).

repo_slug.description: Bounded slug, captured only when URL/remote-anchored.

PullRequestVcsReference.description: A PULL_REQUEST VCS reference with an anchored #N or URL identifier.

identifier.description: An anchored pull-request reference: a #N form or a PR URL. Unanchored numbers and prose are excluded from v1.

repo_slug.description: Bounded slug, captured only when URL/remote-anchored.

CaptureDiagnosticPayload.description: A content-free capture diagnostic. Carries no raw provider record.

context.description: Bounded sanitized context; never a raw provider record, path, or secret.

ObservationEnvelope.description: Fields carried by every observation regardless of kind. run_context is present exactly for stamped attachments and absent for passive sessions.

observation_id.description: Immutable observation identity; permanently binds to one sequence and payload hash.

Observation.description: A single closed, discriminated observation. The discriminator is kind; exactly one variant matches.

ObservationBatch.description: One contiguous immutable source range. Contiguity (first_sequence + len - 1 == last_sequence, and each observation.sequence == first_sequence + index) and the byte ceilings are wire-contract invariants enforced by the server, not by JSON Schema; see x-limits and the 413/422 responses.

IngestAck.description: Success acknowledgement for one ingest batch.

acknowledged_through_sequence.description: Never advances past the request's last_sequence.

duplicates.description: Already-bound records on replay; accepted + duplicates == request length on success.

SourceBinding.description: The authenticated source binding as resolved server-side; carries no client-supplied tenant/workspace.

CapabilitiesResponse.description: Non-mutating capabilities/validation response for setup and doctor. Discloses only the authenticated binding and limits; never accepts a client-supplied authoritative tenant/workspace.

max_record_bytes.description: Maximum encoded bytes for a single observation record (413 boundary).

SourceDescriptor.description: Server-authored source binding state. Tenant/workspace and operator subject come only from verified identity.

workload_subject_fingerprint.description: Bound credential subject/workload-key fingerprint; never the raw credential.

SourceEnrollRequest.description: Enroll a predeclared source. Body never supplies authoritative tenancy or source authorization.

source_id.description: The predeclared endpoint source ID to bind. Tenant/workspace/subject come from verified operator identity, never the body.

SourceDecommissionRequest.description: Permanently revoke a source binding. Irreversible. Decommission revokes ingest; it does not lose already-acknowledged evidence, so it carries NO evidence-loss acknowledgment field (unlike rotation).

SourceRotationRequest.description: Atomically decommission a corrupt namespace and enroll its predeclared replacement.

new_source_id.description: The predeclared replacement source ID; enrolled at sequence one.

acknowledge_evidence_loss.description: Must be true: rotation abandons the corrupt namespace's unacknowledged range, so the operator explicitly acknowledges evidence loss.

SourceRotationResult.description: The result of an atomic source rotation.

QuiescenceRule.description: Versioned client-side quiescence rule. Quiescence is computed by the client from last_evidence_ingested_at; no server path returns a QUIESCENT lifecycle.

ProvenanceValue.description: A typed interpreted field value with its confidence and bounded direct provenance.

evidence_ids.description: Bounded direct evidence IDs; the full set is paged via the evidence endpoint.

UsageByQuality.description: Usage totals for one quality class. Absent token fields stay absent (never zero).

price_table_version.description: Present only for ESTIMATED quality (a server-validated coupling).

UsageByQualityOrigin.description: Usage totals segmented by origin AND quality so the wire cannot express an origin-blind total.

VcsChip.description: A commit/PR chip scoped under one associated run, carrying its per-edge origin.

via_run_id.description: The observing execution run the chip is scoped under; chips are never unscoped bead-level attributes.

AttachmentIntervalSummary.description: A half-open source-sequence attachment interval [start_sequence, end_sequence_exclusive) with its exact start/end evidence anchors and native start source.

end_sequence_exclusive.description: Absent while the interval is open.

start_source.description: The native start source that opened this interval.

start_evidence_id.description: The observation ID whose durable append opened this interval; anchors the provenance drawer.

end_evidence_id.description: The observation ID that closed this interval; absent while the interval is open.

ended_at.description: Occurred-at of the end evidence; absent while the interval is open.

SessionSummary.description: A native session and its immutable attachment intervals.

model.description: Present only when the optional SESSION_LIFECYCLE model field was reported.

TimelineSummary.description: Bounded counts for a run's chronological evidence timeline; the full timeline is paged via the evidence endpoint.

detail.description: Bounded sanitized detail; hostile input, rendered as text by consumers.

RunFieldProvenance.description: Bounded direct field provenance for the interpreted run fields.

outcome.description: v1 always projects UNKNOWN. SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED are reserved for a later contract version and are not valid v1 wire values.

last_evidence_ingested_at.description: Trusted server clock; the client computes quiescence from it and the quiescence_rule.

RunListResponse.description: A run-list page (initial or updates_after incremental).

updates_cursor.description: Opaque workspace projection watermark for updates_after polling.

next_page_token.description: Opaque keyset continuation token; empty string when there is no next page.

RunDetail.description: A run projection detail response. Carries an ETag over (projection_version, projection_revision).

outcome.description: Always UNKNOWN in v1; other values reserved.

EvidenceSummary.description: A typed evidence-timeline summary. Content fields are absent under metadata-only policy (never empty strings).

label.description: Bounded typed summary label (e.g. transition or category); hostile input, rendered as text. No captured content under METADATA_ONLY.

RunEvidencePage.description: A keyset-paginated evidence page pinned to one projection revision.

WorkRunIdentity.description: A work run's identity. Never minted; exists exactly when the referenced group bead exists.

group_bead_type.description: The BTS issue_type of the group bead (deployment-configured; default convoy/epic).

TruncationMarker.description: A hard-cap truncation marker; totals render as 'incomplete (N of M)' when truncated.

BoundedSessionSummary.description: A bounded session summary for a work-run run entry.

model.description: Only when the optional SESSION_LIFECYCLE model field is present.

WorkRunRunSummary.description: The closed embedded summary of one execution run associated with a work-run member.

usage.description: Usage totals by quality, segmented by origin.

BtsMemberSummary.description: A BTS-sourced member summary, composed server-side from the viewer-authorized R2 group graph (frozen beads-api-v1 rev 2 member DTO).

title.description: BTS-sourced; hostile input, rendered as text by consumers.

updated_at.description: BTS-sourced last-update time (frozen beads-api-v1 rev 2 member DTO).

closed_at.description: BTS-sourced close time; present only for closed members.

blocked.description: Precomputed column hint from the member's direct blocks edges (R2), so board columns derive without per-member BTS calls.

blocks_bead_ids.description: Opaque IDs of beads this member is blocked by (R2 direct blocks edges); capped, with blocks_truncation when exceeded.

WorkRunMember.description: One work-run member bead and its associated execution runs.

is_group_bead.description: True when the member is itself a group bead; its members are excluded from this composition and totals.

WorkRunAggregates.description: Origin-segmented work-run aggregates. The wire type cannot express an origin-blind total.

declared_usage.description: DECLARED-only usage totals; the only figures that enter composition.

extracted_usage.description: Structurally segmented EXTRACTED-band totals; never included in composition.

WorkRunDetail.description: A work-run (convoy-as-run) composition detail response. Carries an ETag over the contributing projection revisions and the BTS evaluation watermark.

evaluated_at.description: Composition is over current BTS structure as of this time.

work_axis_available.description: False when the viewer-authorized BTS leg is unavailable; the Observer half is returned with the work axis marked unavailable, never a cached substitute.

ObserverErrorBody.description: The typed body of an Observer error.

code.description: Machine-readable, closed code shared across ingest and read APIs.

ObserverError.description: The single typed error envelope shared by every Observer ingest and read endpoint (application/json).
